C3 random uniform [-mag,mag] vs canonical mag (uniform full-fill) differ in distribution shape AND L2 norm — random ~ mag·sqrt(N/3) whereas canonical_full = mag·sqrt(N). At mag=50 random L2 ≈ 1265, canonical L2 ≈ 1960. Single-axis fills only one span (38–39 dims/cell) so its L2 ≈ mag·sqrt(N·span). Distance comparison is NOT pure shape — magnitude/L2 also varies. A pure shape test would L2-normalize all injects to the canonical L2 first.
C4 5 random seeds is a small sample; 95% CI on phi_range is wide. Adding 50+ seeds would tighten the SUBSTRATE_INTRINSIC vs INJECT_SHAPE_DEPENDENT verdict.
C5 single prompt "안녕". BG-Q showed prompt 1 had 8x larger drift than prompts 2/3/5 — most-favorable. Other prompts may show different attractor structure or stronger shape-dependence.
